ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift
ordered_steps.summary: Audit the translator schema drift before removing the legacy parser shim. This bounded work de-risks subsequent steps by exposing hidden schema issues.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report with concrete findings on translator output vs expected step-id schema

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions. Required after schema audit to ensure fixtures reflect the actual schema.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixtures in tests/plan_contract.py that pass with new step ids

ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature behind kill switch, canary-validated

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Operator runbook and launch checklist updated with proven rollout/rollback procedures

dependency_notes.reason: Schema audit must complete before fixtures can be correctly backfilled to reflect actual translator output
Dashboard summary consumes step-id schema from translator and must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema
Runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation

primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect or unstable step ordering to users if translator schema drift is not audited and fixtures are not updated before enabling the feature
mitigations: Complete schema audit (RN-101) before any downstream work to expose hidden drift
Backfill fixtures (RN-102) and verify tests/plan_contract.py passes before enabling dashboard
Keep dashboard behind kill switch (RN-103) during canary to limit blast radius
Validate rollout/rollback procedures in canary before updating runbook (RN-104)

assumption_ledger.note: Audit may reveal minimal drift, but proceeding without audit risks user-visible failures
Test inventory states no coverage exists for bad dependency ordering; mitigation relies on kill switch
Kill switch infrastructure assumed to be in place for dashboard summary
